name: Khoros
description: Khoros provides social marketing, digital customer care, online community, messaging, and conversational automation products. Its Marketing platform helps brands coordinate governed social activity, conversations, publishing, and customer engagement across teams.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated Khoros Marketing API access token and bind it to one exact company, then let agents verify redacted company authority through the fixed Me endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: KHOROS_MARKETING_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Khoros Marketing access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated API Access Token in the customer's Khoros Marketing Profile Settings. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as a Bearer header to https://api.spredfast.com.

credentialRequirements.name: KHOROS_MARKETING_COMPANY_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Khoros Marketing company ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Paste one exact positive-decimal company ID returned by Khoros Marketing's Me endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read Marketing company authority
capabilities.description: Verify that the customer token can access one exact Khoros Marketing company and return only its bound ID and safe environment value.

approvalRequired.label: Get Khoros Marketing company authority
approvalRequired.description: Verify the exact company binding and return only the bound company ID and safe environment, excluding email, company names, user identity, and broader platform data.

blocked.label: Access identity or company detail
blocked.description: Emails, user IDs, company names, other company IDs, memberships, roles, permissions, teams, credentials, and account configuration are blocked.

blocked.label: Access content, Care, Community, or analytics
blocked.description: Posts, messages, conversations, authors, profiles, cases, queues, tags, assets, listening, analytics, reports, communities, Flow, bots, GDPR data, URLs, media, and customer content remain blocked.

blocked.label: Publish, write, or administer Khoros
blocked.description: Drafting, scheduling, publishing, messaging, engagement, moderation, case changes, imports, exports, webhooks, token changes, user management, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary products, origins, paths, methods, queries, bodies, company overrides, pagination, polling, raw responses, bulk operations, browser sessions, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded company-authority read requires approval; identity, content, Care, Community, Flow, analytics, publishing, writes, administration, raw APIs, pagination, bulk, and export remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; exact company binding, fixed origin/endpoint, redaction, response caps, audits, and provider authorization remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed Khoros Marketing company-authority wrapper with exact company binding and identity redaction.
Hermes receives the same fixed Khoros Marketing company-authority wrapper with exact company binding and identity redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Khoros Marketing API access requires an eligible customer account and a customer-generated user API access token. The token has broad user authority and must be restricted by Relay's fixed wrapper.
providerSetup.nextAction: An eligible customer generates a dedicated Khoros Marketing API Access Token, supplies one exact company ID, and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Khoros documents customer-generated bearer API access tokens, the fixed https://api.spredfast.com/v2/me endpoint, the identity-rich Me response, two-year token lifetime, and user revocation.
Official Marketing documentation describes the platform's governed social marketing/care use cases and directs integrations to the Conversations API access-token flow.
Khoros Care uses separate instance-specific Basic/JWT authentication and API gateways; those incompatible products and credentials are not mounted by this Marketing connector.
Khoros recommends distinct, permission-limited Care API service accounts and Support enablement, reinforcing separation from the selected Marketing token contract.
Khoros terms govern developer and API use; Relay exposes a typed, redacted wrapper rather than redistributing a raw provider API.

securityNotes: The customer-generated Marketing access token and exact company ID are encrypted as secret references; the token is sent only as a Bearer header to https://api.spredfast.com.

Relay allowlists only GET /v2/me, verifies that the exact positive-decimal company appears in the returned companies list, rejects redirects, caps responses at 1 MB, and returns no user email or company name.

Only the bound company ID and a safe environment enum are returned; other companies, user identity, content, authors, profiles, analytics, publishing, writes, administration, pagination, bulk, and export are excluded.
Khoros Care, Community, Flow, Bot, GDPR, Analytics Reports, Basic-auth, JWT, and instance-specific APIs remain separate and unavailable through this connector.
Provider 401/403/429 and server errors are surfaced safely; token creation, capture, revocation acceptance, and provider-console work remain customer/external acceptance steps.
